verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection are fair questions for an AI inference cloud, so the axis applies. The pack documents a zero-retention policy, SOC 2/ISO 27001 certification, and dedicated instances for data isolation, but these are adjacent privacy controls, not a choice of storage or processing region. No evidence shows region selection or residency guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
